After the definition, cover the main topics within the field using a list, expand the parts of the field using definitions and examples. Lastly, logically tie all the parts of the field together for this section.

Constraint : Only use verifiable sources, cite them below each part, flag sections that are uncertain, and check once more if there are parts of this topic that may not be covered within this prompt/research.
